claims.text: 1991 Israel ended general exit permits; Oslo called the West Bank and Gaza 'a single territorial unit, whose integrity will be preserved'; 2000 ban on Gazans studying in West Bank and registry freeze; 2007 'permit to remain'; >500,000 left Gaza via Erez in Sept 2000 vs ~3,000 permits a month in 2013; Gisha's Bashi: 'Families are separated… It's not about security'; Uzi Landau ties Oslo to attacks.

Schneider (ToI analysis, 8 Oct 2023): 'Most of the time, Israeli policy was to treat the Palestinian Authority as a burden and Hamas as an asset'; reports of an early-2019 Likud faction meeting where Netanyahu argued opponents of a Palestinian state should support transfers to Gaza.
Netanyahu to Politico, Nov 2023: 'It's a big lie that I wanted to build [up] Hamas. Ridiculous.' Said Qatar funds moved to prevent humanitarian collapse; Liberman disputed.

Time interview 8 Aug 2024: Netanyahu: 'That's a false statement. I never said that' about 2019 remark; 'It wasn't bankrolling Hamas'; Time cited Margalit 2012, Smotrich 2015; Usher: 'Anything that Hamas didn't have to use out of its own budget freed up money for other things.'
Al-Ansari (Kan, 28 Apr 2024): aid under 'complete Israeli oversight, complete Israeli vetting', 'done for humanitarian reasons'.

Shin Bet summary 4 Mar 2025 named 'atmosphere of quiet' and 'the flow of Qatari funds and their transfer to the military wing and its force build-up' among factors; Iran and Qatar funds a 'strategic buttress'.
Channel 12 (17 Mar 2025): unpublished Shin Bet annex 'The Path to October 7' reportedly says Qatari money policy continued despite repeated warnings and strengthened Hamas.
Raz: from summer 2018 to Oct 2023 about $30m in cash a month; 2018 cabinet approved cash transfers (Raz's account).
Rose (Vanity Fair Apr 2008): covert plan to arm Fatah via Arab states after 2006; Dayton; State Dept called it 'absurd'.
Abbas postponed May 2021 elections citing Israel's refusal on East Jerusalem voting; Hamas: 'a coup against the path of national partnership and consensus'; Israel: 'an internal Palestinian issue'.
